stem.text: What can be concluded from the information about cysteine in haemoglobin?

A.text: More than 1% of the amino acids in one haemoglobin protein are cysteine.

B.text: In α-globin, there is a cysteine closer to the end of the polypeptide chain with an unreacted carboxyl group than in β-globin.
